captures.summary: The local Hermes memory plugin inventory exposes eight candidate substrates spanning user-model memory, knowledge graph/observations, server-side semantic extraction, context databases, local SQLite/FTS, tree memory, and cloud hybrid search.
Holographic is a local SQLite fact store with FTS5, trust scoring, entity links, optional HRR vectors, and explicit add/search/probe/related/reason/update/remove/list tools.

captures.excerpt: Hindsight observations are deduplicated, evidence-grounded beliefs built from multiple retained facts; each observation tracks supporting evidence with quotes and a proof count, evolves as evidence changes, and can be used in recall/reflect alongside raw facts.

Mem0 describes itself as a memory layer for LLM agents with Platform (managed) and Open Source (self-hosted) products. The local plugin supports platform and OSS modes, semantic search, reranking, and explicit list/search/add/update/delete tools.

captures.summary: OpenViking is a context database with filesystem-style viking:// URIs, tiered retrieval, resource ingestion, and automatic extraction. ByteRover is a local-first hierarchical knowledge tree accessed through brv query/curate/status, with optional cloud sync.

captures.excerpt: Honcho gives Hermes prompt-time context injection, cross-session continuity, durable writeback, user and AI peer representations, and tools for profile, search, context/reasoning, and durable conclusions.

captures.browser_title: Overview — What is Supermemory? - supermemory | Memory API for the AI era
captures.excerpt: Supermemory positions itself as long-term/short-term memory and context infrastructure for agents, building a semantic understanding graph over text/files/chats and serving learned user context, user profiles, and advanced semantic RAG.

captures.summary: RetainDB is a cloud memory API with hybrid vector/BM25/reranking search and seven memory types, but the plugin requires RETAINDB_API_KEY and should therefore remain an opt-in remote comparison.
